# cluster-render's C++ client

Copied from [cluster-render](https://github.com/robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps/tree/main/native/cluster-render)
0.6.2 (`client/client.cpp`, `client/protocol.cpp`, `include/cluster_render/client.h` and `protocol.h`), by Robert
Nisipeanu, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE`), unchanged. live2d-render talks to cluster-render with it.
Copy them again from a newer cluster-render when its protocol changes.
